tools.name: tigris.about
tools.description: Describes what Tigris is: globally distributed, S3-compatible object storage with no egress fees.

tools.name: tigris.get_docs_link
tools.description: Returns a link to a Tigris documentation section by topic. Valid topics: quickstart, cli, mcp, sdks, buckets, objects, iam, migration.

tools.name: tigris.get_endpoint
tools.description: Returns the Tigris S3-compatible endpoint URL and environment variables for AWS SDKs.

tools.name: tigris.install_cli
tools.description: Returns the exact shell command to install the Tigris CLI. Choose platform (macos, linux, windows) and optionally method (brew, npm, curl). Docs: https://www.tigrisdata.com/docs/cli/

method.description: Install method. Defaults per platform: macos->brew, linux->curl, windows->npm. brew is not available on windows.

tools.name: tigris.install_mcp_server
tools.description: Returns exact install instructions for adding the hosted Tigris MCP server (https://mcp.storage.dev/mcp) to an agent. Supported: claude-code, cursor, vscode, codex, chatgpt, claude-desktop, goose.

agent.description: Which agent to install the MCP server into.
